title: Sample Certification Quiz
description: Small valid quiz fixture used by the validate-quiz-json hook

questions.question: Which component stores data durably in a columnar cloud data platform?
questions.explanation: Columnar storage keeps data organized by column, which analytical queries scan efficiently.

questions.question: Which term describes separating storage from compute?
questions.explanation: A decoupled architecture lets storage and compute scale independently.

questions.question: Which principle limits user access to only what is required?
questions.explanation: Least privilege grants only the permissions needed to perform a task.
